name: Stone Trolls
game_text:
<keyword>Tale</keyword>. To play, spot Bilbo. Plays on any character. Limit 1 per character.
Each time bearer skirmishes a Troll or Uruk-hai, bearer is strength +3.
flavor_text: “‘For a couple o'pins,’ says Troll, and grins, / ‘I'll eat thee too, and gnaw thy shins. / A bit o' fresh meat will go down sweet!’”
